scope: Production extension workstreams; source delivery and deployment acceptance are separate.

workstreams.title: Customer business connectors
workstreams.required_evidence: HTTP adapter, governed supplier checks, receipt recovery, approval-bound dispatch, unsigned evidence downloads and a disposable synthetic approval/idempotency/recovery/isolation drill are implemented. Real customer sandbox, purchase/idempotency/isolation acceptance and deployment evidence remain.

workstreams.title: Durable agent execution
workstreams.required_evidence: Bounded pause/resume, approvals, cancellation, lease recovery and a disposable synthetic agent-workflow drill are implemented. Autonomous planning, customer-workflow and deployment acceptance remain.

workstreams.title: Document ingestion & OCR
workstreams.required_evidence: Authorized intake, local parsers, reviewed publication, OCR controls, deletion propagation and a disposable DOCX/PDF ingestion drill are implemented. OCR quality, broader file compatibility and deployment acceptance remain.

workstreams.title: Semantic retrieval & reranking
workstreams.required_evidence: Local ACL-first LSA/BM25 retrieval, Arabic normalization and a disposable combined knowledge drill are implemented. Neural embeddings/vector indexing, scalable retrieval, reranking and bilingual relevance acceptance remain.

workstreams.title: Document-level permissions
workstreams.required_evidence: Source ACL enforcement across retrieval, indexing and deletion.

workstreams.title: Bilingual answer evaluation
workstreams.required_evidence: Reviewer-labelled retrieval metrics, precision targets, saved-run comparisons and a disposable synthetic retrieval drill are implemented. Generated-answer quality, grounding, refusal and poisoning evaluation remain.

workstreams.title: Provider resilience
workstreams.required_evidence: Bounded response validation, elapsed-time completion checks, uncertain-outcome accounting and a disposable synthetic inference-control drill are implemented. Model-specific failure behavior, streaming/fallback if required, and live provider acceptance remain.

workstreams.title: Inference traffic controls
workstreams.required_evidence: Shared-database admission limits, concurrency reservations and saturation behavior.

workstreams.title: Usage & cost governance
workstreams.required_evidence: Invoice reconciliation, evidence retention and account-level cost controls.

workstreams.title: Identity & workload lifecycle
workstreams.required_evidence: IdP provisioning/offboarding, verified MFA and workload federation.

workstreams.title: Workspace & environment lifecycle
workstreams.required_evidence: Local lifecycle, membership isolation and reviewed prompt/guardrail/workflow draft copying with pinned reference remapping and receipt recovery are implemented. Pilot lifecycle, general configuration promotion and deployment acceptance remain.

workstreams.title: Secrets & network isolation
workstreams.required_evidence: Managed-secret injection, rotation and deployment-enforced egress isolation.

workstreams.title: Telemetry, alerts & SLOs
workstreams.required_evidence: External logs/metrics/traces, service objectives and operator notification drills.

workstreams.title: Audit integrity & retention
workstreams.required_evidence: Unsigned supplier-check exports and offline format/checksum verification are implemented. Immutable off-host archive, authenticated evidence, retention rules and deployment acceptance remain.

workstreams.title: Encrypted backup & recovery
workstreams.required_evidence: Quiesced snapshots, authenticated encrypted inspection, isolated SQLite recovery copies, disposable SQLite drills and a CI PostgreSQL recovery rehearsal are implemented. Scheduled encrypted backups, deployment application/PostgreSQL recovery acceptance and measured RPO/RTO remain.

workstreams.title: Cloud deployment & rollback
workstreams.required_evidence: Reviewed images, TLS/private networking, staged rollout and recovery evidence.

workstreams.title: Security & load acceptance
workstreams.required_evidence: Independent review, dependency/image scans, penetration and load/soak tests.

workstreams.title: Accessibility & device acceptance
workstreams.required_evidence: Readable text, keyboard/screen-reader checks and responsive device assessment.
